trades.reasoning: Full multi-signal confirmation (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge) makes this the strongest setup on the list even though the broader tape is flat.

decisions.briefing: Markets were roughly flat today (NASDAQ -0.3%, S&P 500 -0.2%), so this wasn't a risk-on day to deploy heavily. We added one position, BCE, since it's the only candidate showing all five bullish confirmation signals including a volume surge, and held the rest of the portfolio unchanged.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today with no major catalyst, reflecting a pause after recent moves rather than a shift in sentiment. Trading stayed within a narrow range as investors awaited clearer signals before committing new capital broadly. This kind of low-volatility, directionless session is typical of a market digesting prior gains.
market_education.summary_zh: 大市今日略為走軟，納指跌0.3%、標普500跌0.2%，並無重大消息刺激，反映市場在早前升勢後進入消化階段。成交保持窄幅波動，投資者在加大注碼前仍在等待更明確的方向訊號。這種低波動、無明顯方向的交易日在大市整固期相當常見。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: On a flat or uncertain market day, it's safer to only buy stocks showing multiple confirming signals together — like a bullish RSI, a MACD crossover, and a volume surge — rather than just one. This combination suggests real buying interest rather than random noise.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 在大市方向不明或持平的日子，較安全的做法是只買入同時出現多個確認訊號的股票——例如RSI處於偏好區間、MACD出現黃金交叉，加上成交量放大——而非單一訊號。這種訊號組合顯示真實買盤參與，而非隨機波動。
